note: Roadmap 13.69, 13.77, 13.80 (27 Nov): each fighter's play style when the computer plays it (either side). The style steers who it strikes, how it walks and when it falls back; its kit rules live in src/aiStyle.js and BattleScene.styleKitChoice. Keyed by unit id (units.json). Numbers: careAt = an ally at or under this share of health is 'hurt' to this fighter (it heals, guards or saves it); fallBackAt = under this share of its own health, with no kill to take and not locked in a clash, it walks back to its friends (0 = never); focus = who it likes to strike: weakest (lowest health, finish the kill), threat (the foe hurting a friend, or the hardest hitter), casters (casters and archers first), nearest.

aggressive.text: Goes for the kill: strikes the weakest foe in reach and walks straight at the enemy line. Never falls back.

protector.text: Guards his friends: strikes whoever is hurting a hurt friend, walks to stand by them, heals or takes the blow for them.

support.text: Keeps the team alive: heals and blesses the friend who needs it most, stays behind the front line, curses the most dangerous foe.

skirmisher.text: Hits and runs: picks off casters and lone foes, keeps out of reach, and saves a friend in trouble when it can.
